description:
"Are you really my dad’s friend’s son?"

One day, Jutae ends up living with Suhan, his father’s old college friend’s son.
Jutae can’t help but feel uneasy and irritated by Suhan’s friendly, easygoing nature.
To make things worse, Jutae’s father, Jaeheon, seems unusually concerned about the relationship between the two.
Thus begins a suspicious cohabitation among three men.

**Original Webtoon:**
